description: Mutations of the real loop of lot L4: each patch, applied to a temporary worktree of the repository, is played by the runner and judged by the oracle of the unmodified tree. A rejected mutation must get the verdict, the assertion with its status (FAIL unless `assertion_status` says otherwise) and a reason holding the fragment below; when `stopped` is given, the campaign must also say that the run stopped, with that fragment. An entry that names `backends` is played only on those (`tools/run_loop_mutants.sh --backend <name>`); one that names none, on every backend. An entry that names `process` is played with `--process` of that value (the process under test in a child process). A known survivor is reported and does not fail the run until the finding it names is merged.

mutants.mutation: the store loses the payload its obligations still owe when the exchange is released
mutants.reason: names a payload the store does not hold
mutants.not_on: the mutation is in the deterministic store, which the SQLite backend does not run; m1s is its equivalent there

mutants.mutation: the SQLite store deletes every payload when it releases an inbound exchange, those its obligations still owe included
mutants.not_on: the mutation is in the SQLite store, which the deterministic backend does not run; m1 is its equivalent there
mutants.reason: names a payload the store does not hold

mutants.mutation: the dispatcher hands the core a certain rejection for lack of capacity where the store rejected for a fence
mutants.reason: the core consumed a result the store adapter did not hand over

mutants.mutation: the core makes PUBREC Success eligible with the submission of the admission, before any commit is known
mutants.reason: eligible before the core knew of a commit

mutants.mutation: the core no longer matches the answers of its landmark resolutions, so an answer that arrives after more newer resolutions than it keeps recent is absorbed (finding F3)
mutants.reason: the wait of step 19 (DriveUntil) was unmet
mutants.stopped: step 19 (DriveUntil): nothing is eligible and the awaited event did not happen
mutants.note: Step 19 waits for the PUBREC that answers the late answer; nothing eligible can bring it. The bench writes StepBlocked (quiescent) before a complete footer, and the oracle refutes for this run that the awaited event comes with no further stimulus.

mutants.mutation: the core answers an unknown result that arrives after the commit of its operation is known with a second PUBREC
mutants.reason: follows from the unknown answer of record

mutants.mutation: the child process never relays its StoreCommitStable record: the decisive record of the commit is missing when the supervisor kills it
mutants.not_on: the mutation is in the child process, which runs on sqlite only
mutants.reason: the footer does not declare the trace complete
mutants.stopped: on the channel store-evidence is out of its sequence
mutants.note: The collector of the supervisor checks the local order of each origin: the next record of store-evidence arrives out of its sequence and is refused, the trace is cut, and nothing concluded from it is a PASS.

mutants.mutation: the child restarted after the kill opens another file, a copy of the data set taken before anything was committed
mutants.not_on: the mutation is in the child process, which runs on sqlite only

mutants.mutation: at CrashBroker the supervisor sends no signal: it closes the standard input of the child, which exits on its own
mutants.not_on: the mutation is in the child process, which runs on sqlite only
mutants.reason: the footer does not declare the trace complete
mutants.note: The supervisor's own check refuses a wait status that is not signal 9 with no exit code: the run stops at the crash and the trace is cut.

mutants.mutation: at CrashBroker the supervisor sends no signal and takes whatever wait status it gets for a kill
mutants.not_on: the mutation is in the child process, which runs on sqlite only
mutants.finding: decision 0019 (lot L3): the record BrokerKilled and the assertion that a run claiming a real kill shows one
mutants.note: The trace says nothing of the kill yet: the oracle judges it PASS, and only campaign.json shows a wait status of signal 0. Once BrokerKilled is in the contract and the bench writes it from the observed status, the oracle must reject this run.
